import os, json, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
# load .env without printing secrets
for line in Path('.env').read_text().splitlines():
    if '=' in line and not line.strip().startswith('#'):
        k,v=line.split('=',1)

token=os.environ['TG_BOT_TOKEN']
chat_id=-5031650278

req=urllib.request.Request(url, data=json.dumps({'chat_id':chat_id}).encode(), headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'}, method='POST')

content.text: Bot 不在该群，改用真人号 Telethon（电报客户端）按约定发 DROP 正文 + CREATE 文件。

cd /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot && python3 - <<'PY'
import asyncio, os, sys
from pathlib import Path

# load env
for line in Path('.env').read_text().splitlines():
    if '=' in line and not line.strip().startswith('#'):
        k,v=line.split('=',1)
        os.environ.setdefault(k.strip(), v.strip())

sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from config import TELEGRAM_API_ID, TELEGRAM_API_HASH, USER_SESSION_PATH
from worker_ant_client import _client_kwargs
from telethon import TelegramClient

CHAT = -5031650278
CREATE_FILE = Path('outgoing/create_dws_app_page_visit_d_d_paimon_shadow.sql')

DROP_MSG = (
    '@wangyi00001 生产 SR 帮重建影子表 dws.dws_app_page_visit_d_d_paimon_shadow，先执行 DROP：\n\n'
    'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS dws.dws_app_page_visit_d_d_paimon_shadow;'
)
CREATE_CAPTION = '@wangyi00001 再建表，按这个文件跑 CREATE（uid_cnt=BITMAP，分桶/动态分区对齐正式表）'

async def main():
    client = TelegramClient(USER_SESSION_PATH, TELEGRAM_API_ID, TELEGRAM_API_HASH, **_client_kwargs())
    async with client:
        entity = await client.get_entity(CHAT)
        title = getattr(entity, 'title', None) or getattr(entity, 'username', None) or str(CHAT)
        print('chat=', title, 'id=', getattr(entity, 'id', None))
        m1 = await client.send_message(entity, DROP_MSG)
        print('drop_msg_id=', m1.id)
        m2 = await client.send_file(entity, str(CREATE_FILE), caption=CREATE_CAPTION)
        # send_file may return list
        mid = m2[0].id if isinstance(m2, list) else m2.id
        print('create_file_msg_id=', mid)
        print('DONE')

asyncio.run(main())
PY
